_comment: Project settings for the rdocx workspace. Local overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored. The allow-list is the toolchain documented in CLAUDE.md and the command surface in .claude/WORKFLOW.md, plus the git and GitHub surface that /release, /close-sprint and /spec-bump need. The deny-list holds only the operations that destroy work irrecoverably. The rule that only /close-sprint merges to main or creates an sNN tag, and only /release creates a release tag, is enforced by the command files, by close-preflight and by sprint review, not by this file.
